answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The pulse edge is recorded both ways, so a closed ring of 199 clones produces a signature the sonnet analysis flags immediately. An hostile operator must as a result build an open graph reaching real agents, and as a result doing work rather than printing keys, and the ledge settlement applies the void retroactively. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
